mapper.sql: (select coalesce(sum(case when i.receipt_batch_detail_id is not null then coalesce(i.accepted_quantity, 0) + coalesce(i.concession_quantity, 0) when i.qc_result in ('passed', 'concession') then i.quantity else 0 end), 0) from inv_inbound_record i where i.purchase_order_id = d.order_id and (i.purchase_detail_id = d.detail_id or (i.purchase_detail_id is null and i.product_id = d.product_id and (select count(*) from inv_purchase_detail legacy where legacy.order_id = d.order_id and legacy.product_id = d.product_id) = 1)))
mapper.select: select d.*, as stocked_quantity from inv_purchase_detail d where d.order_id = #{orderId} for update
mapper.insert:
insert into inv_purchase_detail ( order_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, warehouse_id, product_name, sku, spec, unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, received_quantity ) values
(#{item.orderId}, coalesce(#{item.itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{item.itemId}, #{item.productId}), #{item.itemCode}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.productId}, #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.sku}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.amount}, #{item.receivedQuantity})
